label: Accepting or rejecting a step
subgoals: Scale each error estimate by its tolerance
Accept the step when the worst ratio is at most one
Retry rejected steps from the last accepted point with a smaller step

label: The step-size update formula
subgoals: Take the ratio of tolerance to error
Raise it to one over p plus one
Multiply by the step and the safety factor

label: Breakpoints and step growth limits
subgoals: Cap it at twice the previous step
Cut it to land exactly on the next breakpoint
